title: Idle worktree target/ dirs accumulate until C: fills (0 bytes at 2026-10-17 07:29Z); add a retention sweep
outcome: Build output in idle TermAl worktrees no longer grows without bound. A documented, path-checked sweep (or a policy that agents follow) removes target/ dirs of worktrees whose work has landed or is idle, before free space gets low.
acceptance: A written retention rule (CLAUDE.md or docs/test.md) says when a worktree's target/ is removed and who removes it, with the path check from 'Work only in the repository folder'.
A free-space warning appears before a gate starts, from the launcher or another check, so a gate isn't launched with less than a stated threshold free.

completion.summary: Completed the path-checked target/ retention policy and pre-gate disk-space preflight on the TRAIN-5 tree.
